section.home.announcement.subtitle: Established in 2005 and headquartered in Brooklyn, New York
section.home.announcement.desc: Etsy is a global online marketplace focused on handmade, vintage, and unique goods. Its mission is 'Keep commerce human'.
section.home.mission.title: Global Presence & Scale
section.home.mission.desc: Etsy operates as an international e-commerce platform serving millions of buyers and sellers worldwide, with employees in multiple countries. In fiscal year 2023, Etsy reported over USD 2.6 billion in revenue.
section.home.services.title: Business & Market Overview
section.home.services.item1: Business Segments: Etsy operates globally as an online marketplace connecting independent sellers with buyers of handmade, vintage, and unique goods. The platform includes operations across the United States and international markets but does not operate physical retail stores.
section.home.services.item2: Market Position: Etsy is recognized as a leading global e-commerce marketplace within the handmade and creative goods sector, focusing on community-driven commerce, digital innovation, and sustainable growth.

modal.info.title: Platform User Rules
modal.info.rule1:
1. Daily Task Completion
Users are required to complete 2 sets of orders per day for the day to count as a valid check-in.
Upon each valid check-in day, users will receive an additional basic salary issued by the platform.
modal.info.rule2:
2. VIP Membership & Commission Structure
Each VIP level offers different commission rates and exclusive benefits.
For example: Upgrading to VIP1 unlocks 5 additional daily tasks, significantly increasing overall earning potential.
modal.info.rule3:
3. Game Distribution & Promotional Activities
The platform provides promotional games through the TFC system.
Users may participate in these activities to support partner merchants and earn additional task rewards.
modal.info.rule4:
4. Withdrawal Policy
All withdrawal requests require a 1-hour processing period.
Once processing is completed, funds will be credited to the user’s account and made available for withdrawal.
modal.info.rule5:
5. Task Completion Requirements
The system automatically assigns appropriate task combinations based on the user’s account balance and capacity.
All allocated tasks must be completed within 24 hours.
Failure to complete tasks on time may result in:
- Withdrawal delays
- Account suspension
- Financial losses for both users and partner merchants, as promotional games may also be affected.
modal.info.rule6:
6. Commission Multipliers
Certain combined orders may offer a commission multiplier of 3× to 50×, depending on the system’s allocation mechanism and the user’s VIP level.

tnc.title: Terms and Conditions
tnc.content:
1. Account Balance Requirements

1.1 Users must maintain a minimum balance of 50 USDT to activate their accounts.

1.2 After completing all assigned tasks, users may request withdrawals. However, at least 100 USDT must remain in the account in order to continue daily tasks. Withdrawal requests will only reset once the funds have been successfully credited.

1.3 Users may invite friends to join the Trade Me platform as sub-accounts. For every task completed by an invited user, the referrer will receive a 0.25 USDT referral commission.

2. Account Security

2.1 Users must not disclose their account passwords to anyone. The platform is not responsible for losses resulting from password leaks.

2.2 If a user forgets their login or withdrawal password, they must contact online customer support for verification and reset assistance.

2.3 Users and merchants are bound by a confidentiality agreement to ensure secure and seamless cooperation.

2.4 All tasks are carried out by real users to promote and increase visibility for merchant-developed games and promotional products.

2.5 Once a user begins work, they must maintain account activity and credibility in order to continue participating in optimization tasks.

3. Fund Security

3.1 All funds are securely stored in the user’s Trade Me account wallet and may be used for task participation or withdrawal.

3.2 To prevent losses, all transactions are processed through the TFC system, ensuring consistent and secure returns for users.

3.3 If a user’s balance or withdrawal amount exceeds the system’s threshold, an overdraft fee of 5%–10% is required to unlock the high-value withdrawal channel. Once activated, users may withdraw both the overdraft fee and the remaining funds.

3.4 In cases of accidental loss or exceptional circumstances, the platform provides full compensation to protect user interests.

3.5 For each deposit exceeding 500 USDT, the platform awards a 20% bonus to encourage continued activity and level upgrades.

4. Task Optimization

4.1 Users of different levels receive corresponding commissions and bonuses.

4.2 Membership tiers include: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond.

4.3 Upon completing optimization tasks, both the commission and task principal will be automatically credited back to the user’s wallet balance.

4.4 Task allocation is based on the user’s account balance, and commission amounts are calculated accordingly.

4.5 Once a task has been assigned, it cannot be cancelled or skipped. All tasks must be completed within the same day to maintain merchant brand integrity.

4.6 Task values and commission rates scale proportionally based on the user’s account balance.

4.7 Each user group will be randomly assigned a set of combination tasks. Assigned tasks cannot be cancelled or skipped once distributed.

5. Deposits & Wallet Verification

5.1 Users may restart or reactivate their accounts at any time. The platform does not restrict the number of restarts.

5.2 If additional funds are needed for combination tasks, users must recharge according to the negative balance displayed in their accounts.

5.3 Before depositing, users must verify the merchant’s wallet address through customer service.

5.4 The platform is not responsible for any losses caused by depositing funds into incorrect wallet addresses.

6. Trade Me E-commerce Merchants

6.1 Merchant orders refresh every minute. If task data is not uploaded on time, the system may fail to record it. To protect merchant credibility, all tasks must be completed within 24 hours, otherwise the user will lose withdrawal eligibility.

7. Additional Provisions

7.1 If a user forgets their withdrawal password, a 500 USD verification deposit is required to confirm account ownership.
